item.title: Bulletin updated at 20:30 HKT 25/Jul/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Gaemi will move across Fujian and weaken gradually today and tomorrow. With the southwest monsoon over the northern part of the South China Sea becoming active, showers will increase with a few squally thunderstorms over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. A broad trough of low pressure will bring heavy showers to the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of southern China early next week. A southerly airstream is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week. There will still be a few showers over the region.

Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers and squally thunderstorms. More showers at first. Sunny intervals in the afternoon.
Temp range: 28 - 32 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium
